requirements.title: LGT STRING_A and STRING_B argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING_A shall be default character or ASCII character, and STRING_B shall be character with the same kind type parameter as STRING_A.

pending.LGT-STRING_A-default-or-ASCII-character: Positive source plan calls LGT with default character operands containing only ASCII characters; source-control mutation changes STRING_A to integer and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.LGT-STRING_B-same-character-kind-as-STRI: Positive source plan uses same-kind character operands; source-control mutation changes STRING_B kind and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LGT pads the shorter string with blanks before comparison
requirements.definition: For unequal lengths, LGT compares as though the shorter string were extended on the right with blanks to the longer length.

pending.LGT-blank-padding-shorter-left: Assert LGT("A","A!") is false because the left operand compares as "A "; mutate the right operand to "A " so the padding distinction is load-bearing.
pending.LGT-blank-padding-shorter-right: Assert LGT("A!","A") is true because the right operand compares as "A "; reverse operands to fail the direction check.

requirements.title: LGT is true for ASCII following and false otherwise
requirements.definition: For ASCII operands, LGT is true for STRING_A following STRING_B in the ASCII collating sequence, and false otherwise.

pending.LGT-following-true: Use ASCII-discriminating following pairs with result sentinel .false.: LGT("A","9"), LGT("a","Z"), LGT("a","A"), and LGT("_","Z") all true from ASCII codes '9'=57, 'A'=65, 'Z'=90, '_'=95, 'a'=97; include each reverse as a false companion so native collation cannot satisfy the plan.
pending.LGT-equal-strings-false: Use equal ASCII operands "Az" and "Az" with result sentinel .true. and assert false; mutate intrinsic to LGE so equality fails.
pending.LGT-preceding-false: Use ASCII-discriminating preceding pairs with result sentinel .true.: LGT("9","A"), LGT("Z","a"), LGT("A","a"), and LGT("Z","_") all false from ASCII codes '9'=57, 'A'=65, 'Z'=90, '_'=95, 'a'=97; include each reverse as a true companion.
